name: Togawa
source:
A rising star in the Kyoto Prefectural Police, newly recruited but already full of promise. Though still fresh on the force, he is not afraid to speak his mind even to his superior Katsuki, and carries himself with admirable confidence. At his side is Suburi-Chan, a baby anteater-shaped ARI assistant who is undeniably adorable... and may also hold unexpected surprises. 

[From [url=https://duskindexgion.bushiroadgames.com/en/#character]Official English website[/url]]
